WideIntegerColumnReference.role: A read of a native int8 member by its resolved occurrence and field position.
WideIntegerColumnReference.structure: Two nonnegative integer coordinates identifying an occurrence and an int8 slot owned by that occurrence.
WideIntegerColumnReference.conditions: The parent checks that the slot is visible and has the native int8 kind. An incompatible source cannot occupy the same role.
WideIntegerColumnReference.meaning: Read an exact signed 64-bit integer or SQL NULL, including NULL extension and exported derived values.
WideIntegerColumnReference.sql: Emit the owned physical or generated local column and occurrence alias.

structure: Native int8 fields retain their own slot kind in physical input and independent derived headings. Projection, grouping parentheses, presence tests and resolved builtin casts compose over the field. Explicit Boolean-to-int4 and text-to-text conversions use their own native field roles.
conditions: Validate every reference over the actual visible kind. Resolve the same target across grouped and ungrouped forms without retaining the source spelling. A builtin cast only accepts a checked source and target edge. The native bigint to int4 narrowing keeps its possible data-dependent overflow.
meaning: Observe exact signed field values, NULL and DISTINCT. An identity cast keeps int8, a signed narrowing cast preserves values in int4 or raises SQLSTATE 22003 on a row outside its range. A presence test yields a Boolean. Group parentheses around one field leave its resolved coordinates and result name intact.
sql: Render exact qualified field names, typed casts, aliases and preserved positional result order.
